verdict.rationale: Superset's prompt-first flow lets a developer describe a task in plain language, pick an agent, and have it immediately spun up in its own scoped Git worktree/branch (docs-18, docs-16), and orchestration features let a plain-language ask like a migration be split into independent scoped worker tasks (docs-14, docs-25). However, this is agent-launching, not a distinct spec/ticket-generation step — there's no evidence of an intermediate structured 'implementation spec' artifact being produced from the description before work begins. Missing for 10: an explicit spec/plan-generation output separate from just starting the agent, and evidence of automatic scoping/requirements extraction rather than direct prompt-to-execution.
